utterances.text: How nice! Go more to the middle. Slower, slower, slower, slower. Let's accelerate. Go to the other side. Stop now, but you have to say stop. Stop. More.
Yes. So we test him better. Oh, my God. Okay, you can go. Like froggy, jump.
Wait, like the game? Am I supposed to 'jump' the speed limit here or dodge the puddles like an obstacle course?
What? No, no games! I mean the car is hopping because your foot is shaky on the clutch. Like a little frog hopping. You must stay steady.
Oh, okay. I thought you wanted me to zigzag. My bad.
No zigzagging! Just steady. Go to the middle of the puddle.

Don't let be disturbed because some of them may run across the road and you will see them. Don't worry, don't worry until you're not ready to drive. Concentrate on the bottom of the car. Get ready to stop or touch the bottom and very gently—
Too fast, too fast. Take hold. So we start here. Yes, I believe you can drive.
